function: Stat.AdjustControl / AdjustCPBonus / AdjustCraftsmanship (Player entity, SkillType, int)
description: Adds to the per-skill value of a Player record, creating the entry at zero first.
inputs: 3 methods x skills {Invalid, Armor, Lightsaber}, adjusted by +6 and then by -10 (the second step shows the entry is kept and can go negative).
